metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Python 3.11+ RS274 G-code simulator at [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py).

It supports the requested CLI inputs/outputs, parameter and tool files, modal machine state, core linear/arc/probe/cycle motions, trace sampling modes, error JSON output, and parameter persistence. Verified it compiles and exercised linear-motion trace output.
